https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/valveO.label: valve operation
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/valveO.description: The method of valve operation where: DROPWEIGHT: A valve that is closed by the action of a weighted lever being released, the weight normally being prevented from dropping by being held by a wire, the closure normally being made by the action of heat on a fusible link in the wire FLOAT: A valve that is opened and closed by the action of a float that rises and falls with water level. The float may be a ball attached to a lever or other mechanism HYDRAULIC: A valve that is opened and closed by hydraulic actuation LEVER: A valve that is opened and closed by the action of a lever rotating the gate within the valve. LOCKSHIELD: A valve that requires the use of a special lockshield key for opening and closing, the operating mechanism being protected by a shroud during normal operation. MOTORIZED: A valve that is opened and closed by the action of an electric motor on an actuator PNEUMATIC: A valve that is opened and closed by pneumatic actuation SOLENOID: A valve that is normally held open by a magnetic field in a coil acting on the gate but that is closed immediately if the electrical current generating the magnetic field is removed. SPRING: A valve that is normally held in position by the pressure of a spring on a plate but that may be caused to open if the pressure of the fluid is sufficient to overcome the spring pressure. THERMOSTATIC: A valve in which the ports are opened or closed to maintain a required predetermined temperature. WHEEL: A valve that is opened and closed by the action of a wheel moving the gate within the valve.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/valveM.label: valve mechanism
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/valveM.description: The mechanism by which the valve function is achieved where: BALL: Valve that has a ported ball that can be turned relative to the body seat ports. BUTTERFLY: Valve in which a streamlined disc pivots about a diametric axis. CONFIGUREDGATE: Screwdown valve in which the closing gate is shaped in a configured manner to have a more precise control of pressure and flow change across the valve. GLAND: Valve with a tapered seating, in which a rotatable plug is retained by means of a gland and gland packing. GLOBE: Screwdown valve that has a spherical body. LUBRICATEDPLUG: Plug valve in which a lubricant is injected under pressure between the plug face and the body. NEEDLE: Valve for regulating the flow in or from a pipe, in which a slender cone moves along the axis of flow to close against a fixed conical seat. PARALLELSLIDE: Screwdown valve that has a machined plate that slides in formed grooves to form a seal. PLUG: Valve that has a ported plug that can be turned relative to the body seat ports. WEDGEGATE: Screwdown valve that has a wedge shaped plate fitting into tapered guides to form a seal.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/lampBa.label: lamp ballast type
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/lampBa.description: The type of ballast used to stabilise gas discharge by limiting the current during operation and to deliver the necessary striking voltage for starting. Ballasts are needed to operate Discharge Lamps such as Fluorescent, Compact Fluorescent, High-pressure Mercury, Metal Halide and High-pressure Sodium Lamps. Magnetic ballasts are chokes which limit the current passing through a lamp connected in series on the principle of self-induction. The resultant current and power are decisive for the efficient operation of the lamp. A specially designed ballast is required for every type of lamp to comply with lamp rating in terms of Luminous Flux, Color Appearance and service life. The two types of magnetic ballasts for fluorescent lamps are KVG Conventional (EC-A series) and VVG Low-loss ballasts (EC-B series). Low-loss ballasts have a higher efficiency, which means reduced ballast losses and a lower thermal load. Electronic ballasts are used to run fluorescent lamps at high frequencies (approx. 35 - 40 kHz).

Values in the enumeration list follow a standard international code where the first letter describes how the primary windings are connected, the second letter describes how the secondary windings are connected, and the numbers describe the rotation of voltages and currents from the primary to the secondary side in multiples of 30 degrees. D: means that the windings are delta-connected. Y: means that the windings are star-connected. Z: means that the windings are zig-zag connected (a special start-connected providing low reactance of the transformer). The connectivity is only relevant for three-phase transformers.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/applic.label: application
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/applic.description: Humidifier application. Fixed: Humidifier installed in a ducted flow distribution system. Portable: Humidifier is not installed in a ducted flow distribution system.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasIdentifie.label: has identifier
https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasIdentifie.description: Links some entity to its identifier. Extensions of SAREF may define sub-properties such as s4abcd:hasUUID, s4abcd:hasGTIN12, etc.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasFunction.label: has function
https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasFunction.description: Links a feature kind or a device to one of its functions.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/endSha.label: end shape type
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/endSha.description: Defines the types of end shapes that can be used for preformed tanks. The convention for reading these enumerated values is that for a vertical cylinder, the first value is the base and the second is the top for a horizontal cylinder, the order of reading should be left to right. For a speherical tank, the value UNSET should be used.B5

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/hasLoc.label: has lock
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/hasLoc.description: Indication of whether a switching device has a key operated lock (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

https://saref.etsi.org/core/accomplishes.label: accomplishes
https://saref.etsi.org/core/accomplishes.description: Links a certain entity (e.g., a device) to the task it accomplishes.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasTimestamp.label: has timestamp
https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasTimestamp.description: Links a procedure execution or a profile to an instant.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isObservedBy.label: is observed by
https://saref.etsi.org/core/isObservedBy.description: Links a feature, property, or state, to the device, function, command, or procedure execution, that observes it.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasVersion.label: has version
https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasVersion.description: Links some entity (e.g., a device) to its version.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/isSpac.label: isSpaceOf
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/isSpac.description: Relation between a building space and the building or building space it belongs to.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isOfferedBy.label: is offered by
https://saref.etsi.org/core/isOfferedBy.description: Links a service to the device that exposes it to a network

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasRevisionN.label: has revision number
https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasRevisionN.description: Links some entity (e.g., a device) to its revision number.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasPropertyK.label: has property kind
https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasPropertyK.description: links a property of interest to its kind, a property.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasModel.label: has model
https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasModel.description: A relationship identifying the model of an entity (e.g., device). The value is expected to be a string or a string with language tag.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isAccomplish.label: is accomplished by
https://saref.etsi.org/core/isAccomplish.description: A relationship identifying an entity (e.g., a device) that can accomplish a task.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/hasDef.label: has defrost
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/hasDef.description: Whether the heat exchanger has defrost function or not.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasCommandKi.label: has command kind
https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasCommandKi.description: links a command of interest to its kind, a command.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/shortC.label: short circuit voltage
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/shortC.description: A complex number that specifies the real and imaginary parts of the short-circuit voltage at rated current of a transformer given in %.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isProfileOf.label: is profile of
https://saref.etsi.org/core/isProfileOf.description: Links a profile to the device it describes. The device should be linked to a certain commodity using OP saref:consumes, saref:produces, or saref:stores, and optionally to some property or state using OP saref:targets or its sub-properties.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/sprayT.label: spray type
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/sprayT.description: SprayFilled: Water is sprayed into airflow. SplashTypeFill: water cascades over successive rows of splash bars. FilmTypeFill: water flows in a thin layer over closely spaced sheets.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/madeExecutio.label: made execution
https://saref.etsi.org/core/madeExecutio.description: Links an entity (e.g., device) to the procedure execution it made.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasOptionalC.label: has optional command
https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasOptionalC.description: Links a function and one of its optional commands

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/powerS.label: power source
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/powerS.description: Type of power driving the compressor.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/switch.label: switch function
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/switch.description: Indicates types of switches which differs in functionality.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/evapor.label: evaporation medium type
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/evapor.description: ColdLiquid: Evaporator is using liquid type of fluid to exchange heat with refrigerant. ColdAir: Evaporator is using air to exchange heat with refrigerant.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/consistsOf.label: consists of
https://saref.etsi.org/core/consistsOf.description: A relationship indicating a composite entity that consists of other entities (e.g., a temperature/humidity sensor that consists of a temperature sensor and a humidity sensor)

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/contro.label: control strategy
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/contro.description: FixedExitingWaterTemp: The capacity is controlled to maintain a fixed exiting water temperature. WetBulbTempReset: The set-point is reset based on the wet-bulb temperature.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/offers.label: offers
https://saref.etsi.org/core/offers.description: Links a device to a service it exposes to a network.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/represents.label: represents
https://saref.etsi.org/core/represents.description: Links a service to some function or function of interest it exposes to the network. Also links an operation to some command or command of interest it exposes to the network.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/isExte.label: is external
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/isExte.description: Indication whether the element is designed for use in the exterior (TRUE) or not (FALSE). If (TRUE) it is an external element and faces the outside of the building.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/failPo.label: fail position
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/failPo.description: Specifies the required fail-safe position of the actuator.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/isNeut.label: is neutral secondary terminal available
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/isNeut.description: An indication of whether the neutral point of the secondary winding is available as a terminal (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/evapor.label: evaporation coolant
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/evapor.description: The fluid used for the coolant in the evaporator.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/operat.label: operation
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/operat.description: The operational mechanism for the damper operation.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isStateOf.label: is state of
https://saref.etsi.org/core/isStateOf.description: Links a state to the feature kind or feature of interest it is a state of.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isTargetOf.label: is target of
https://saref.etsi.org/core/isTargetOf.description: Links a feature, property, or state, to the device, function, command, or procedure execution, that targets it.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasStateKind.label: has state kind
https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasStateKind.description: links a state of interest to its kind, a state

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/fireEx.label: fire exit
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/fireEx.description: Indication whether this object is designed to serve as an exit in the case of fire (TRUE) or not (FALSE). Here whether the transport element (in case of e.g., a lift) is designed to serve as a fire exit, e.g., for fire escape purposes.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/placem.label: placement type
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/placem.description: Indicates how the device is designed to be placed.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isProducedBy.label: is produced by
https://saref.etsi.org/core/isProducedBy.description: Links a commodity to the feature kind, feature of interest, or device, that produces it

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isCommandOfI.label: is command of interest of
https://saref.etsi.org/core/isCommandOfI.description: Links a command of interest to the function of interest it is a command of.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasPhenomeno.label: has phenomenon time
https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasPhenomeno.description: Links a procedure execution to the time that the result applies. It may be an interval or an instant, or some other compound temporal entity expressed using OWL Time.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isStateOfInt.label: is state of interest of
https://saref.etsi.org/core/isStateOfInt.description: Links a state of interest to the feature of interest it is a state of.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/isWate.label: is water storage heater
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/isWate.description: This is used to identify if the boiler has storage capacity (TRUE). If FALSE, then there is no storage capacity built into the boiler, such as an instantaneous hot water heater.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/readOu.label: read out type
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/readOu.description: Indication of the form that readout from the meter takes. In the case of a dial read out, this may comprise multiple dials that give a cumulative reading and/or a mechanical odometer.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isMeasuredIn.label: is measured in
https://saref.etsi.org/core/isMeasuredIn.description: A relationship identifying the unit of measure used for a certain entity.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isPropertyOf.label: is property of
https://saref.etsi.org/core/isPropertyOf.description: Links a property to the feature kind or feature of interest it is a property of.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/lampCo.label: lamp compensation type
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/lampCo.description: Identifies the form of compensation used for power factor correction and radio suppression.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/patter.label: pattern type
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/patter.description: Defines the types of pattern (or shape of a tank that may be specified.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/mechan.label: mechanical operated
https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/mechan.description: Indication whether the element is operated machanically (TRUE) or not, i.e. manually (FALSE).

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isControlled.label: is controlled by
https://saref.etsi.org/core/isControlled.description: Links a feature, property, or state, to the device, function, command, or procedure execution, that controls it.
